job_description:
StableNaira is looking for a Senior Blockchain Engineer to build secure fintech infrastructure for payments, wallet integrations, liquidity movement, and digital asset settlement.

Responsibilities

Develop, test, and maintain Solidity smart contracts.
Build backend services, APIs, and transaction-processing systems.
Integrate wallets, blockchain APIs, and EVM-compatible networks.
Improve gas efficiency, transaction reliability, and settlement performance.
Support architecture planning, security reviews, testing, CI/CD, monitoring, and documentation.
Troubleshoot blockchain, backend, and distributed-system issues.
Collaborate with engineering, product, DevOps, and compliance teams.
Requirements

4+ years of professional software development experience.
Strong Solidity, smart contract, and EVM knowledge.
Backend experience with Node.js, TypeScript, Go, or Python.
Experience with Web3 libraries, wallets, APIs, databases, and REST services.
Understanding of smart contract security, gas optimization, and reliable transaction processing.
Familiarity with Docker, Kubernetes, distributed systems, or CI/CD.
Strong communication, debugging, and independent remote-working skills.
Nice to Have

Experience with stablecoins, DeFi, fintech, Layer 2 networks, bridges, audits, high-availability systems, or open-source blockchain projects.

Work Arrangement

Fully remote, direct engagement with StableNaira. Full-time or long-term contract options are available.
